comment: A single segment with no gate patched and no loop set is routed to ProcessZero in the firmware's process function table, so its output sits at 0V; the same segment with loop set is routed to ProcessFreeRunningLFO. The module allows two looping segments in a group, which mark a loop's start and end; toggling a third clears the loop from the other two.
